QuestInfo.name: [Lunar New Year Mission] Deliver Blaster's Message
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Blaster again to get the finished message.
QuestInfo.1: Blaster's message is for #bInstructor Elex#k, who raised her as a member of the Resistance. Elex is stationed in #bEdelstein's Secret Plaza#k for rear missions.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered Blaster's message to #bElex#k, and he couldn't hide his joy at hearing from her.

default.0: You can reach the Secret Plaza through Edelstein's sewers. And don't worry. It's not as dirty as you'd think.
